summary: The submission was an exact duplicate of the correction already retained, so the controller deduplicated it as no_change: the record still shows the client-change fact at revision 2 citing the configuration entry at log index 106, matching its receipt, with the prior index-110 wording preserved only in the history and explained in the changed-premise note. Nothing new was changed this turn. The account therefore stands as the last accepted state: the question explained and the defect claim asserted, every consequence identified in this run exercised under its own receipts — bounded non-progress, leadership and commits resting on a minority of the committed configuration, a client-acknowledged commit that either rests on one copy or is discarded from every store, a vote and leadership granted without entitlement, a client membership change that replaces the committed configuration without its majority, two leaders in the same term under a partition, and, after healing, one leader with both divergent committed entries still present — with the strongest result reproduced twice from retained fixed inputs, all quoted operands audited against their receipts, no gaps open, and only the store and fault-model boundaries recorded as limitations.
